integrity: The proof is written for arbitrary admissible trees and fields. Exact finite tests are independent supporting checks, not proof for the infinite family. Same-model assessment is not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple trees with exactly two even-degree vertices; only open-neighbor linear updates over finite fields of characteristic two. The nilpotent transient entrance-time distribution is not classified. Coverage by unavailable unindexed literature remains a priority uncertainty.
title: The two-defect tree parity automaton is a reversible path wave after transients
